proposals.evidence: Full pānīya gives Marwari/Gujarati/Marathi pāṇī, regional pāni and reduced nasal-vowel forms such as Poguli pāĩ. These support Mewari phaṇi and Dungra Bhili pãʔĩ provisionally, preserving source aspiration/glottalization and qualifying their local history and cross-IA transmission. Exact response: pãʔĩ.
